blocks.text: Yeh chapter 25 (Organic Synthesis) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Explain the role of functional groups in organic synthesis. (4 marks)
(Organic synthesis mein functional groups ka kirdar wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Functional group: organic compound ka woh hissa jahan ziyada tar reactions hote hain.
2. Organic chemistry functional groups ke gird tarteeb di gayi hai: lakhon organic compounds maloom hain magar functional groups sirf chand hain aur har aik compounds ki aik family ki pehchaan hai.
3. Organic synthesis mein hum saade, aasani se milne wale hisson se target molecule banane ke mukhtalif tareeqe design karte hain. Is design mein functional groups markazi kirdar ada karte hain.
4. In se chemists un reactions ka andaaza aur control kar sakte hain jo aakhir kaar matloob product tak le jate hain.
5. Functional group pehchanne se compound ki properties ka andaaza hota hai. Yeh naye organic products banane aur medicines aur food additives jaise products ki purity aur composition yaqeeni banane ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: In organic synthesis we design different possible ways to build a target molecule from simpler easily available components.

blocks.prompt:
2 What points must be considered when planning the synthesis of an organic compound? Describe the two categories of reactions used in organic synthesis. (4 marks)
(Organic compound ki synthesis ki mansooba bandi mein kin baaton ka khayal rakhna chahiye? Organic synthesis ke reactions ki do qismein bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Khayal rakhne wali baatein:
• Organic compound banane se pehle har step ke chemical reactions, reagents aur halaat samajhna zaroori hai taake target molecule kamyabi se bane.
• Ziyada tar organic compounds kai mukhtalif raaston se ban sakte hain, is liye behtareen raasta chunne ke usool (criteria) chahiye.
• Achhi synthesis saste aur aasani se milne wale starting materials ko kam se kam steps aur ziyada overall yield wale raaste se product mein badalti hai.

Reactions ki qismein:
1. Functional group interconversions (FGI): aik functional group doosre mein badla jata hai.
2. Carbon-carbon bond banana: yeh khaas ahem hain kyun ke synthesis ki bunyaadi strategy target molecule ko saade aur chhote starting materials se jorna hai.

book_ref.quote: Most organic compounds can be prepared by a number of different routes

blocks.prompt:
3 What is synthesis? Explain with equations how a primary aliphatic amine can be prepared in one step from a haloalkane and in two steps from an alcohol. (4 marks)
(Synthesis kya hai? Equations ke saath wazeh karein ke primary aliphatic amine haloalkane se aik step mein aur alcohol se do steps mein kaise banti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Synthesis: target molecule ko saade, bazaar mein milne wale compounds se shuru kar ke banaya jata hai. Final target molecule tak pohanchne ke liye kai steps ya tabdeeliyan ho sakti hain.

Aik step (haloalkane se): haloalkane ko ammonia ke saath react karaya jata hai.
R–CH₂–Cl + NH₃ → R–CH₂–NH₂ + HCl

Do steps (alcohol se): haloalkane aasani se nahi milta, is liye ise alcohol se banate hain jo starting material ke taur par aasani se milta hai.
Step 1: R–CH₂–OH → (SOCl₂) R–CH₂–Cl
Step 2: R–CH₂–Cl → (NH₃) R–CH₂–NH₂ + HCl

book_ref.quote: For example, primary aliphatic amine can be prepared in a single step

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe retrosynthesis and the disconnection approach. Which bonds are disconnected, and how is the route then used for synthesis? (4 marks)
(Retrosynthesis aur disconnection approach bayan karein. Kaun se bonds disconnect kiye jate hain aur phir yeh raasta synthesis mein kaise kaam aata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Retrosynthesis synthesis ka bilkul ulat hai. Target molecule ko kam pecheeda, saade aur aasani se milne wale compounds mein toda jata hai jo starting material ban saken.
2. Is mein disconnection approach hoti hai: TM ko khayali taur par qadam ba qadam saade starting materials mein torna. Har step khule retrosynthetic arrow ⇒ se dikhaya jata hai.
3. Chune jane wale bonds: target molecule ke woh bonds disconnect kiye jate hain jin se structure kaafi saada ho jaye.
4. Disconnection se synthons (aksar ionic tukre) bante hain. Yeh aam taur par unstable hote hain, is liye in ki jagah synthetic equivalents (asal reagents) liye jate hain jo react kar ke target molecule de saken.
5. Kai disconnections ke baad saade, aasani se milne wale starting materials mil jate hain. Phir synthesis aage ki taraf (→) in starting materials se target molecule tak ki jati hai (Figure 25.1).

book_ref.quote: In retrosynthesis, those bonds of the target molecule are disconnected

blocks.prompt:
5 Explain the following terms used in retrosynthesis, giving an example from the chapter where possible: (i) target molecule (ii) disconnection (iii) synthon (iv) synthetic equivalent (v) retrosynthetic tree. (4 marks)
(Retrosynthesis ki yeh istelahaat wazeh karein, jahan mumkin ho chapter se misaal dein: (i) target molecule (ii) disconnection (iii) synthon (iv) synthetic equivalent (v) retrosynthetic tree.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Target molecule (TM): woh molecule jise tayyar karna hai, maslan ethyl acetate, aniline, paracetamol.
(ii) Disconnection: TM ko khayali taur par qadam ba qadam saade starting materials mein torna, khule retrosynthetic arrow ⇒ se dikhaya jata hai; maslan nitrobenzene ko C–N bond par disconnect karna.
(iii) Synthon: target molecule ka woh tukra jo disconnection se banta hai. Synthons aksar ionic species hote hain aur synthesis ke building blocks hain, maslan C₆H₅⁻ (aryl anion) aur NO₂⁺ (nitronium cation).
(iv) Synthetic equivalent (SE): woh reagent jo synthon ka kaam karta hai, kyun ke synthon aam taur par unstable hone ki wajah se khud istemal nahi ho sakta, maslan C₆H₅⁻ ke liye benzene aur NO₂⁺ ke liye nitric acid.
(v) Retrosynthetic tree: woh diagram jo target molecule se starting materials tak tamam mumkina disconnections aur synthons dikhata hai (Figure 25.2 tamam istelahaat aik scheme mein dikhati hai).

book_ref.quote: Figure 25.2 shows all the terminologies in a single scheme.

blocks.prompt:
6 What is functional group interconversion (FGI)? Explain its role in designing synthetic routes, with two examples of FGI taken from the retrosyntheses in this chapter. (4 marks)
(Functional group interconversion (FGI) kya hai? Synthetic raaste design karne mein is ka kirdar wazeh karein aur is chapter ki retrosyntheses se FGI ki do misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
FGI: aik functional group ko doosre functional group mein badalna jo kisi khaas compound ki synthesis ke liye zaroori ho, taake target molecule tak pohancha ja sake.

Kirdar:
• FGI target molecules tak le jane wale raaste design karne mein ahem kirdar ada karti hai.
• FGI ko building blocks bana kar saade starting materials ko ziyada pecheeda target molecules mein badla ja sakta hai.
• FGI se na sirf target molecule ka carbon skeleton banta hai balke ikhtiyar kiya jane wala raasta bhi chuna jata hai.
• Pichhle chapters ki interconversions Figure 25.3 (aliphatic) aur Figure 25.4 (aromatic) mein khulasa ki gayi hain.

Misaalein:
1. Aniline ⇒ nitrobenzene: –NH₂ ko –NO₂ banaya jata hai kyun ke nitro group electrophilic substitution se benzene par aasani se lagta hai, jab ke amino group nucleophilic substitution se nahi.
2. 4-Aminophenol ⇒ 4-nitrophenol (paracetamol ka raasta): p-nitrophenol aasani se banta hai aur phir reduce ho kar p-aminophenol deta hai.

book_ref.quote: FGI is a phenomenon to change a functional group into another functional group

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain the retrosynthesis of ethyl acetate, naming the synthons and synthetic equivalents, and then give its synthesis with the equation. (4 marks)
(Ethyl acetate ki retrosynthesis wazeh karein, synthons aur synthetic equivalents ke naam likhein, phir equation ke saath is ki synthesis dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Target molecule: ethyl acetate, CH₃COOC₂H₅.

Step I, disconnection: TM ko dikhaye gaye ester bond (CH₃CO–OC₂H₅) par disconnect kiya jata hai jis se synthon A (CH₃CO⁺) aur synthon B (C₂H₅O⁻) milte hain.
Step II, synthetic equivalents: synthons ko neutralize karne se acetic acid (synthon A ke liye) aur ethanol (synthon B ke liye) milte hain. Yeh saade starting materials hain aur react kar ke target molecule de sakte hain, jo inhein chunne ki shart hai.

Synthesis: acetic acid aur ethanol ke darmiyan jaana pehchana esterification reaction, H₂SO₄ catalyst ke saath:
CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH → (H₂SO₄) CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O

book_ref.quote: For our target molecule ethyl acetate, the disconnection followed by neutralization yields acetic acid and ethanol

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain step by step the retrosynthetic analysis of aniline, giving the reason for each step. (4 marks)
(Aniline ke retrosynthetic tajziye ko step ba step wazeh karein aur har step ki wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Target molecule: aniline, C₆H₅–NH₂.

Step I, functional group interconversion: aniline ⇒ nitrobenzene. Amino group (–NH₂) ko nitro group (–NO₂) mein badla jata hai. Wajah: benzene par nitro group electrophilic substitution se aasani se lagta hai, jab ke amino group nucleophilic substitution se nahi.

Step II, disconnection: nitrobenzene ko C–N bond par disconnect kiya jata hai jis se synthons aryl anion (C₆H₅⁻) aur nitronium cation (NO₂⁺) bante hain.

Step III, synthetic equivalents: synthons unstable hain, is liye inhein neutralize kar ke synthetic equivalents benzene (C₆H₅⁻ ke liye) aur nitric acid (NO₂⁺ ke liye) liye jate hain.

Yun aniline ke saade starting materials benzene aur nitric acid hain.

book_ref.quote: In second step the disconnection of nitrobenzene was done from C—N bond

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the retrosynthesis of acetophenone and design its synthesis. Name the process and the catalyst. (4 marks)
(Acetophenone ki retrosynthesis bayan karein aur is ki synthesis design karein. Process aur catalyst ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Target molecule: acetophenone, C₆H₅COCH₃.

Step I, disconnection: TM ko ring aur acyl group ke darmiyan C–C bond par disconnect kiya jata hai jis se synthons aryl anion (C₆H₅⁻) aur acylium cation (CH₃CO⁺) bante hain.
Step II, synthetic equivalents: synthons ko neutralize karne se benzene (C₆H₅⁻ ke liye) aur acyl chloride, CH₃COCl (CH₃CO⁺ ke liye) milte hain.

Synthesis: benzene AlCl₃ catalyst ki maujoodgi mein acyl chloride se react karta hai. Yeh process Friedel-Craft acylation hai.
C₆H₆ + CH₃COCl → (AlCl₃) C₆H₅COCH₃ + HCl

Yahan retrosynthesis mein C–C bond ka disconnection synthesis mein C–C bond banane wale reaction ke barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: In first step the disconnection of acetophenone (TM) was done from C—C bond

blocks.prompt:
10 Explain the reasoning behind each choice made in the retrosynthesis of paracetamol: why the amide C–N bond is disconnected first, why FGI is used, and what the final disconnection gives. (4 marks)
(Paracetamol ki retrosynthesis mein har faisle ki wajah wazeh karein: amide ka C–N bond pehle kyun disconnect hota hai, FGI kyun istemal hoti hai, aur aakhri disconnection se kya milta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Amide ka C–N bond pehle kyun (Steps I-II): paracetamol ko amide group ke C–N bond par disconnect kiya jata hai. Milne wale synthons ke synthetic equivalents, 4-aminophenol aur acyl chloride, nucleophilic addition-elimination reaction se react karne ke liye mashhoor hain, is liye amide aasani se dobara ban jata hai.

2. FGI kyun (Step III): 4-aminophenol ko 4-nitrophenol mein badla jata hai. Yeh is liye ke p-nitrophenol aasani se banta hai aur phir reduce ho kar p-aminophenol deta hai.

3. Aakhri disconnection (Steps IV-V): 4-nitrophenol ko C–N bond par disconnect kiya jata hai jis se 4-hydroxy aryl anion (HO–C₆H₄⁻) aur nitronium cation (NO₂⁺) milte hain. In ke synthetic equivalents phenol aur nitric acid hain.

4. Nateeja: pecheeda dawa phenol jaise saade starting material tak pohanch jati hai. Phir synthesis aage chalti hai: phenol → 4-nitrophenol → 4-aminophenol → paracetamol.

book_ref.quote: The bond is broken at the position indicated because the synthetic equivalents

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Is sawal mein 'kyun' ahem hai: pehla bond wahi toda jata hai jis ke SE aasani se react kar ke wapas bond bana saken; FGI wahan ki jati hai jahan naya group lagana aasan ho (nitro group) aur baad mein use badla ja sake (reduction).

blocks.prompt:
11 Both aspirin and paracetamol are synthesized starting from phenol. Compare their retrosynthetic routes step by step. (4 marks)
(Aspirin aur paracetamol dono phenol se banaye jate hain. In ke retrosynthetic raaston ka step ba step muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono dawaein pecheeda lagti hain, lekin sahi disconnections dono ko phenol (saade starting material) tak le jati hain. Raaston ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Aspirin and Paracetamol, both are synthesized starting from phenol.

rows: Step I: amide group ke C–N bond par disconnection
Step I: ester linkage ke C–O bond par disconnection
Step II: SE 4-aminophenol aur acyl chloride (nucleophilic addition-elimination se react karte hain)
Step II: SE salicylic acid aur acetic anhydride
Step III: FGI 4-aminophenol ⇒ 4-nitrophenol (aasani se banta hai, phir reduce hota hai)
Step III: carboxylic group ke C–C bond par Disconnection-II
Steps IV-V: 4-nitrophenol ka C–N disconnection HO–C₆H₄⁻ + NO₂⁺ deta hai; SE phenol aur nitric acid
Step IV: SE phenol aur carbon dioxide
Starting materials: phenol, nitric acid, acyl chloride
Starting materials: phenol, carbon dioxide, acetic anhydride

blocks.prompt:
12 Explain why retrosynthesis is important in the synthesis of pharmaceutical products, using the examples of paracetamol and aspirin. (4 marks)
(Pharmaceutical products ki synthesis mein retrosynthesis kyun ahem hai, paracetamol aur aspirin ki misaalon se wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Retrosynthesis ka aik sab se ahem istemal pharmaceutical (dawaai) products ki synthesis mein hai.
2. Saikron qeemti dawaai compounds structure mein bohat pecheeda lagte hain, lekin agar unhein sahi aur mo'assar tareeqe se disconnect kiya jaye to woh bohat saade aur aam milne wale starting materials tak le aate hain. Yahi organic synthesis ki khoobsurti hai: mo'assar retrosynthetic steps ke baad pecheeda aur daraawna structure saada aur qabil-e-husool lagta hai.
3. Paracetamol: is ki seedhi synthesis mein kai steps hain; yeh silsila is ki retrosynthesis (C–N disconnection, 4-nitrophenol tak FGI, C–N disconnection) se samjha jata hai jo phenol aur nitric acid tak le jati hai.
4. Aspirin: retrosynthesis batati hai ke phenol se aspirin banane ke liye kitne aur kaun se steps chahiye (ester ka C–O disconnection salicylic acid aur acetic anhydride tak, phir C–C disconnection phenol aur carbon dioxide tak).
5. Yun retrosynthesis batati hai ke saade starting materials se dawa tak pohanchne ke liye kaun se reactions kis tarteeb mein chahiye.

book_ref.quote: There are hundreds of valuable medicinal compounds, which look very complex in their structure

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe how artificial intelligence was used by researchers at MIT to discover halicin. What problem was it meant to solve? (4 marks)
(MIT ke researchers ne halicin dhoondne ke liye artificial intelligence kaise istemal ki? Yeh kis mushkil ka hal tha?)
blocks.explanation:
Mushkil: pichhle kuch dahaiyon mein bohat kam nayi antibiotics bani hain aur woh bhi purani se thori si mukhtalif. Maujooda tareeqe bohat mehnge, waqt lene wale aur chemical activity ke tang daaire tak mehdood hain, aur pathogens (bacteria) aam antibiotics ke khilaf resistant ho rahe hain.

AI ka istemal:
1. MIT ke researchers ne machine-learning algorithm banaya jo aisi chemical features dhoondta tha jo molecules ko E. coli bacteria maarne mein mo'assar banati hain.
2. Model 2500 molecules aur 800 natural products ke set par lagaya gaya jin ke structures mukhtalif aur bioactivities wasee thin.
3. Is ne aik molecule chuna jis mein antibacterial khasusiyaat ki peshgoi thi aur jis ka structure maujooda antibiotics se mukhtalif tha.
4. Aik doosre model ne dikhaya ke yeh molecule ghaliban insaani cells ke liye kam zehreela hoga.
5. Is molecule ka naam halicin rakha gaya. Mareezon se liye gaye bacterial strains par test karne par is ne duniya ke bohat se mushkil bacteria maar diye jo pehle ilaaj ke khilaf resistant the.

book_ref.quote: In order to find out a solution to this problem the researchers at MIT

blocks.prompt:
14 After identifying halicin, how was the computer model used further? Why is this work called groundbreaking? (4 marks)
(Halicin ke baad computer model ko mazeed kaise istemal kiya gaya? Is kaam ko inqilabi (groundbreaking) kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Model ka mazeed istemal:
1. Researchers ne apna computer model database se chune gaye 10 crore (100 million) se ziyada molecules ki screening par lagaya.
2. Yeh screening sirf teen din mein mukammal hui.
3. Is ne 23 mazeed molecules chune jin ke structures maujooda antibiotics se mukhtalif the.
4. In mein se aath molecules ne antibacterial activity dikhayi aur do khaas taur par taaqatwar the.

Inqilabi kyun: aam dawa banane ke tareeqe bohat mehnge, waqt lene wale aur tang daaire tak mehdood hain. Chand dinon mein karoron molecules jaanchna aur maujooda antibiotics se mukhtalif naye structures dhoondna nayi dawa ban sakne wale organic molecules dhoondne ka bilkul naya raasta dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: This groundbreaking work points out an altogether different route to discover new organic molecules
